description: Letter Chomp: a maze of paper-cream corridors seen from above, charcoal walls, Rimon peeking in from the entrance
Falling Letters: a tall stone well with a soft glow at the bottom, loose letter tiles drifting down like leaves (no readable letters)
Letter Twins: a café table with face-down cards in a neat grid, Ari and Noa seated at the sides
Sound Snap: a garden lawn with round holes, an ear-shaped flower in the corner, dusk light
Look-Alike Sorter: three wooden sorting bins on a market table, Noa holding up two look-alike tiles (blank)
Alef-Bet Run: a running track curving across a Tel Aviv beach promenade, Rimon mid-stride
Final Five: five coat hooks by a door with five little coats, warm hallway light
Letter Drop: rain falling in soft lanes over a market street, Noa holding a wicker basket, Ari calling with a hand to his mouth
Vowel Stack: a tower of smooth blocks on a workbench, Ari balancing the top one
Syllable Snake: a garden path winding between pomegranate bushes, a long trail of leaf tiles behind Rimon
Word Builder: a construction site with a small wall of blank bricks going up, Noa in a hard hat handing a brick
Meltdown: a hot Tel Aviv afternoon, Noa under a beach umbrella holding an ice pop that is just beginning to drip
Flap the Vowel: a sky over the sea with soft cloud gates, Rimon flying with two tiny leaf wings
Letter Bingo: a community hall table with a bingo card and dauber, Ari at a lectern with a tumbler of balls (no letters visible)
Word Search: a newspaper spread on a café table, a pencil, a cup of coffee, morning light
Mini Crossword: a crossword-shaped lattice of white squares floating over Jerusalem stone, pencil and eraser
Word Maze: hedges of a garden maze with stepping stones in the paths, Rimon at the gate
Scramble: letter tiles tumbling out of a tipped bag onto a kitchen table, Noa laughing
Bubble Word: soap bubbles rising over a bathtub, Rimon blowing a bubble wand
True or Not: two doors side by side, one green and one red, in a Bauhaus hallway
Letter Crush: a candy-shop counter with rows of coloured gems in a glass case
Letter Sudoku: a grid of tiles on a chalkboard easel in a classroom, chalk dust in the light
Quiz Ladder: a TV quiz studio with a tall glowing ladder, Ari as host at a podium, Noa at a side desk
Speed Type: an old typewriter and a modern laptop side by side on a desk, coffee, a window onto the sea
Gender Split: Ari on the left and Noa on the right of a market square, a stream of blank word tiles between them
Plural Pop: balloons rising over a Jerusalem rooftop at sunset, Rimon holding the strings of two of them
Sentence Train: a small steam train on a platform, Noa in a conductor cap with a whistle, carriages with blank sides
The Seven Laws: a wooden ark on a calm sea under a rainbow, seven doves in a row (no text)
The Ten Words: two rounded stone tablets on a mountain top at dawn, blank faces, light breaking over them
613 Sorter: a long library shelf of tall scrolls, a ladder, two stacks of cards, one green and one red
